text: Source audit rejected the FSL course candidate: official website explicitly limits course data to educational use, not research. Stopped only this session downloader; no course data processed or committed. Revised bounded path: natively fit FLIRT functional->T1 and FLIRT/FNIRT T1->standard from the already source-verified CC0 demo1 BOLDref/T1 pair, with a separately licensed/pinned TemplateFlow template. This qualifies composition of newly fitted real FSL outputs, not reproduction of a historical FEAT fit or anatomical accuracy. Temporary macOS native runtime already computed valid applywarp/convertwarp results. Matching masks/template provenance are next.
